description: The plot titled “Massive Activation of baseline” illustrates how the maximum activation value varies across model layers for four series (attn_output, attn_residual, ffn_output, ffn_residual). The x-axis is labeled “Layer,” uses a linear scale, and spans approximately layers 0 to 23 with labeled ticks at 0, 5, 10, 15, and 20. The y-axis is labeled “Max Activation Value,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 0 up to about 1600 with regularly spaced tick labels every 200 units. The blue dashed line (attn_output) stays near 0 for most layers and then rises late, reaching roughly ~250 by the final layer. The orange dotted line (attn_residual) is near 0 through about layer 5, jumps to around ~1400 at about layer 6, stays high around ~1500–1600 through roughly layers 14–21, and then drops sharply near the end to a few hundred by the last layer. The green dash-dot line (ffn_output) is near 0 at early layers, shows a sharp spike around layer 5 (around ~1400), returns close to 0 for several layers, has another prominent spike around layer 13 (around ~800), remains low afterward, and then spikes again near layer 22 (around ~1200) before dropping back down by the final layer. The red solid line (ffn_residual) is near 0 through about layer 5, jumps to about ~1400 around layer 5–6, increases to roughly ~1500 and then ~1600 by around layers 14–15, stays near ~1600 through about layer 21, and then drops steeply near layer 22 to around ~400 before ending higher (around ~600) at the last layer.
